description: Request screening of company or person names against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list and the UN Security Council list. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Hypothesis: EUR 0.50–3 per name; human-reviewed matches from EUR 5.

additional_data.description: Optional: countries, dates of birth, registration numbers to reduce false positives.

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

purpose.description: Purpose of the screening (e.g. supplier onboarding).

name: request_sanctions_screening
title: Request sanctions list screening (EU/UN)
